aligned.tex.caption:
Identity-column repair F1 under aligned and whole-table information. Aligned uses the same chunks,
  20 labeled tuples and error positions; Baran is the mean of three runs. Whole-table Baran
  uses perfect detection. TabClean uses DeepSeek-V4-Pro with development rows excluded.

beers.tex.caption:
Qwen3.8-Max shows a positive knowledge effect on Beers. Identity-column F1, total
  O$-$S, repaired cities (O/F/W/S, of 127), and exact W-versus-S chunk sign tests, Holm-corrected over models.
  $^{*}$F is descriptive because its brewery concentration and alcohol distribution differ.
  $^\dagger$: significant as in Table~\ref{tab:main}, corrected over eight differences.

checks.tex.caption: Acceptance checks, run on every controlled table before any model sees it: 506 checks over 21 tables.

construction.tex.caption:
Controlled-table sources and scale. Error counts in parentheses are identity cells;
  values renamed are distinct one-to-one replacements. Seeds cover F, W and S.

decomposition.tex.caption:
Identity-column repair F1 at seed 0. Nonpaired F$-$W uses fresh records; paired contrasts
  use O/W/S. $^\dagger$: Holm-corrected $p<0.05$ over 40 differences (two-sided chunk bootstrap,
  2,000 resamples).

detection.tex.caption:
Detection and repair diverge on surrogate identity columns. Entries give detection F1 /
  repair F1; detection counts corrupted cells found regardless of the value proposed for that cell.

example.tex.caption:
Hospital identity fields across conditions, with the corrupted city in bold.
  O/W/S share a row and error position. $^*$F draws a newer registry row with updated quality
  measures, rather than a row-paired replacement of O.

moviescols.tex.caption:
Where knowledge acts on Movies: DeepSeek-V4-Pro repairs by column (repaired / errors).
  Identity columns are listed first; each condition uses its own error counts.

near.tex.caption:
Director rewrites toward real-world credits are frequent, while city rewrites are rare.
  Rates use each model's known subset of the common target pool, with one row per target.
  Movies: a Director edit matching at least one real credit, with standard and table-evidence
  prompts (95\% entity-bootstrap intervals). Hospital and Beers: city edits matching the real
  city, standard prompt. Rates and interval endpoints retain the source precision.

p1.tex.caption:
Highest hard-cell continuation accuracy over datasets under the full-table structural screen.
  Columns distinguish clean/dirty context, naming and error-row selection.
  Leakage pools clean-reference hits from dirty context over hard erroneous cell-trials.

publicverification.tex.caption:
Public verification entries for the three analyses. Movies uses numerical witnesses
  for cleaning and conflict results, and separately bound uniform continuation counts. The README
  maps each entry to its input files and generated results.

seeds.tex.caption:
Identity-column contrast ranges over three construction seeds; seed 0 is in
  Table~\ref{tab:main}. Fresh clean records are fixed while errors are redrawn.
